body.x: REMO introduced smart home security system at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' held in Las Vegas on January 7th (Sunday).

REMO has developed mobile apps, consumer technologies, safety and security products, smart home appliances / energy management, and wireless devices. REMO's DoorCam, introduced at this CES, helps the security system to be secured. It is easy to install wherever you live. The antenna and Wi-Fi chipset is placed inside the user’s home to limit Wi-Fi connection interference from thick building materials. DoorCam operates on 3 D batteries that lasts for up to 12 months. Power can also be very efficient.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
